gist.headline: The greenhouse got measured
gist.blurb: The bot made its daily lap through the app garden, checking which seedlings are thriving and which ones need a little sun.
gist.summary: Updated the app directory metrics, health-check results, and GREENHOUSE status snapshot for 2026-08-02.
gist.impact: Community builders and maintainers have a current view of listed app activity and health without changing app behavior.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy greenhouse maintenance scene: Polli acts as a tiny garden inspector with a clipboard, checking code-plants labeled as community apps while a CRT monitor robot displays simple green health indicators. The visual represents an automated daily status refresh rather than a new product capability.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene inside a warm community app greenhouse, where Polli—the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee with pink rectangular blush, black oval eyes, light blue translucent wings, and a tiny gardener visor—checks lime green (#ecf874) code-plants with a clipboard while a friendly CRT monitor robot shows small healthy sprout indicators. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: "DAILY CHECK".
